name: How long does it take to complete the electrical portion of a typical home addition?
description: Electrical work for a home addition can take a few days to several weeks, depending on project size and complexity.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete the electrical portion of a typical home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The electrical portion of a home addition varies in duration based on the size and complexity of the project. For a small room addition, it might take a few days to a week. Larger additions, especially those requiring new service panels or extensive wiring, could take several weeks. This timeframe includes rough-in wiring, fixture installation, and final testing. Coordination with other trades and inspection schedules also influence the overall timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Electrical work for a home addition can take a few days to several weeks, depending on project size and complexity.
